description: This is a React functional component named `NotesOptions`, written in TypeScript, responsible for rendering a context menu with various options for managing notes within a note-taking application. It includes functionalities like locking notes, showing/hiding previews, protecting notes, starring, pinning, sharing/exporting, duplicating, archiving, trash management, and additional note-specific actions, often utilizing external services and hooks.

classes.name: NotesOptions
classes.description: A React functional component providing a menu of actions for notes such as locking, starring, sharing, duplicating, archiving, trashing, and other note-specific options, assembled with various hooks, callbacks, and external services.

methods.name: downloadSelectedItems
methods.description: Handles exporting selected notes, either as a single file or zip archive, with user feedback via toasts.

methods.name: downloadSelectedNotesOnAndroid
methods.description: Exports notes on Android platform, invoked via external function.

methods.name: closeMenuAndToggleNotesList
methods.description: Closes the current menu and toggles the notes list pane.

methods.name: duplicateSelectedItems
methods.description: Duplicates the selected notes and then updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: openRevisionHistoryModal
methods.description: Opens the note revision history modal for the first selected note.

methods.name: enableSuperMarkdownPreview
methods.description: Triggers the command to enable Markdown preview in a super note.
